name: Claude Desktop & Code bridge
description: Brings Claude Desktop and Claude Code into OpenClaw: the chat tree by project folder, continuing old chats in agents, live run status, drag-and-drop order, and live import of Claude Code memory

projects.description: Project folder (folder name in the tree) → agent id

defaultAgent.description: Agent for folders without a project (default: main)

defaultFolder.description: Folder for new sessions of the default agent (default: _no_space)

order.description: Folder order in the "Projects" section, top to bottom; unlisted folders follow alphabetically

adoption.description: Adoption of old chats by the agent of their folder, in the Gateway (needs the OpenClaw fork grant OPENCLAW_PLUGIN_GATEWAY_METHODS; without it claude-code-catalog.mjs adopts)

enabled.description: Adopt in the Gateway at start, every 10 minutes and when the tree changes (default: true; false leaves adoption to claude-code-catalog.mjs)

memorySync.description: One-way copy of Claude Code memory (~/.claude/projects/<folder>/memory) into the memory of the agent of its project folder

enabled.description: Run the live sync in the Gateway (default: false; check `node claude-bridge/memory-sync.js --dry-run` first)

root.description: Projects tree root: Claude Code chats under <root>/<Folder> belong to that folder (no default: set by the ai-workbench installer from WORKBENCH_CLAUDE_DESKTOP_ROOT; without it the live sync stays off)

secretsFiles.description: Local .env files whose secret values (*PASS*, *TOKEN*, *SECRET*, *KEY*) are replaced with ‹secret› before memory is copied; patterns are applied in any case. Default: ~/.openclaw/.env
